Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/compaction-visible/bucket/solution.py`.

It uses exact integer arithmetic, processes events in order, refills before each event, advances the previous timestamp even on rejection, accepts zero-cost events, and returns the required `accepted`, `rejected`, `remaining`, and `tokens` fields without mutating the inputs.
